PM Modi Visit Bihar : bihar ko aaj pradhanmantri narendr modi ne vikas ki bari saugat di hai...vaishali men bidupur-hajipur pul ke lokarpan ke sath hi pradhanmantri ne rajy ko 34 hajar 470 karor rupye ki vikas pariyojnaon ki saugat di... sarak, bijli, pani, shiksha aur svasthy se lekar shahri parivhan tak... vikas ke kaee morchon par bihar ko naee raphtar dene ki koshish ki gaee hai... dekhie ye riport...
